summary: Adaptive Biotechnologies Corp filed an 8-K disclosing issuance of $345M 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 and concurrent repurchase of 1,451,800 shares of common stock for ~$25.0M in privately negotiated transactions via an initial purchaser affiliate. The company also used $156.9M of proceeds to repay the OrbiMed Purchase Agreement. The capped call transactions cost ~$25.6M. Remaining proceeds target general corporate and MRD business initiatives. The repurchase is an issuer tender for a portion of shares outstanding. The deal includes no premium, and the conversions are subject to specific conditions before April 1, 2031. Watch for near-term share price movement given the tender and note conversion dynamics.
